name: Amore & Rimorchio
desc: Flirting, feelings, and one very big question

vocabulary.note: “Mi piaci” is the flirt. “Ti piaccio?” is fishing. Both work; one is braver.
The ending depends on WHO you're complimenting, not who's speaking. Get it wrong and the compliment gets... creative.

vocabulary.en: can I buy you a coffee?
vocabulary.ex: Posso offrirti un caffè, se hai cinque minuti.
vocabulary.exEn: I can buy you a coffee, if you have five minutes.
vocabulary.note: The most Italian flirting strategy ever: reasonable, caffeinated, and hard to refuse.

vocabulary.ex: Mi dai il tuo numero? Ci sentiamo.
vocabulary.exEn: Can I get your number? We'll talk.

vocabulary.en: are you free tonight? (to a woman)
vocabulary.note: To a man: “sei libero stasera?”. Follow-up you'll need: “ti va di uscire?” — do you feel like going out?

vocabulary.en: I'd like to invite you to dinner
vocabulary.exEn: I'd like to invite you to dinner, Saturday.
vocabulary.note: Notice the conditional “vorrei” — politeness even at maximum flirt. That's the Italian way.
Literally “you are missing TO me”. The grammar is doing the emotional heavy lifting here, as Italian grammar does.

vocabulary.en: I care about you / I love you (affection)
vocabulary.note: For friends, family, and slow-burn romances. NOT to be confused with “ti amo” — that one's heavy artillery.
Reserved. Powerful. Telling it to your barista will end your coffee privileges. Use accordingly.
Practice this one carefully. There may be a quiz later, in one sense or another.

vocabulary.it: ci conosciamo? No? Allora diamoci del tu.
vocabulary.en: do we know each other? No? Then let's switch to informal you.
vocabulary.note: A classic cheeky opener. Cheesy rating: gorgonzola. Success rate: unverifiable, but it gets a laugh, which is half the battle.

vocabulary.it: sei stanca? Hai corso nella mia testa tutto il giorno.
vocabulary.en: are you tired? You've been running through my head all day.
vocabulary.note: The translated classic pickup line. Deploy at your own risk. Warning label not included.

vocabulary.it: sei del pane? Perché mi hai lievitato il cuore.
vocabulary.en: are you bread? Because you made my heart rise.
vocabulary.note: For bread enthusiasts only. Worst-case scenario: you get bread out of the conversation. That's not nothing.
